scope: Read-only independent recomputation of backend and memory only; source70 retention already accepted; not release approval. No application/harness execution.
limitations: Two independent observations per comparable lane on one local host; no confidence interval or general production claim.
Backend uses fixture assertions; this lane does not archive full decoded HTTP payloads and has no database workers.
Journey row measures cold legacy compatibility reader; lifetime Journey logging/UI is retired.
Ordinary residency is not forced-GC retention; ordinary phase timings are diagnostic intervals, not whole-process or first-Assets user latency.
Retention markers intentionally preserve process/module singletons; RSS is allocator/process residency, not retained JS size; ten cycles are not a no-leak proof.
Session hash equality covers system/time/duration/active route fields and combat groups, not all reports/replays/sovereignty/events; raw hash bodies are not present.
Diagnostic SQL row counts are rows returned, not pages scanned, and diagnostics are not used as timings.
Root owns global envelope audit and other agents own routes/Maps/browser; no conclusion for those lanes here.
